name: v27-d-08-thinking-warning
objective: v2.7 08 option A live (D) row, no model. Harvest on and knowledge tracking on; five /sendas replies made into 'generated' replies through ST's own message fields (extra.api set, not 'manual'; extra.reasoning empty) and saved: four are not enough (no finding, the window is not filled), the fifth raises model-not-thinking (snapshot.thinkingSilent) with the player copy in player mode and no detail; Author view adds the detail and the settings line under the harvest switch (#so-inner-harvest-silent); one reply carrying reasoning clears it; with harvest off the same silent replies raise nothing. so-ui assert-player-clean with the finding shown. Cleanup restores the install-wide memory settings. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-d-08-thinking-warning.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" (a no-model lane: st-lanes.mts no-model <n>).

requires.why: the replies are /sendas posts given extra.api through ST's message fields, so nothing generates; the real-reply leg (fix vs thinking overlay) is v2.8 01 O9

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so the message ids below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const memory = rt.getGlobalSettings().memory; globalThis.__v27d08 = { harvest: memory.harvestReasoning === true, capable: memory.epistemicLedgerCapable === true }; rt.setMemorySettings({ harvestReasoning: true, epistemicLedgerCapable: true }); return globalThis.__v27d08;

import_story.title: SO-V27D08 Thinking
import_story.description: v2.7 08 live row: replies with and without reasoning while harvest is on.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); if (!rt.getSnapshot().ready) throw new Error(`the story did not load: ${rt.getSnapshot().status}`); if (!SillyTavern.getContext().groupId) throw new Error('not a group chat'); return { cadence: 0, storyId: rt.getSnapshot().storyId };

steps.send: We wait for the storm to pass.

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin The wind is still howling.
/sendas name=Arin The innkeeper brings more candles.
/sendas name=Arin Someone knocks at the door.

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin It is only the wind after all.
